role: Minimal institution-organization baseline for the current proprietary trading game: one governance layer and five named departments.
invariants: the current institution is a proprietary trading firm with 10 million USD starting proprietary capital
institution_organization_v1 is the authoritative runtime owner of opening proprietary capital
global oil market-capacity binding is not expected at the initial 10 million USD scale and remains a diagnostic rather than a realism gate
external AUM, management-company economics, management fees, payroll and operating-company cash are not modeled in v0.1
Investment Decision is a governance layer, not a sixth operating department
the current Investment Decision layer owns strategy capital authorization and risk-policy approval
the current single-strategy system proxy authorizes 100 percent of proprietary capital by default
capital authorization remains distinct from CRO risk limits, PM deployment preference and actual margin usage
Investment Decision has no committee-member roster, voting model or personnel capability score in v0.1
Administration is a named fifth department shell only
Administration has no runtime logic, personnel capability model, payroll, recruiting, operating-cost or cash-flow model in v0.1
future multi-strategy allocation and administration mechanics must be added through new versioned contracts rather than inferred from this shell
